subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

When pigs fly
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Something that will never happen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"When pigs fly"** means something that will never happen. (ऐसी चीज जो कभी नहीं होगी)

 
 
• **Example: **He will apologize to you when pigs fly.
 
 
 
• **"Something that will never happen"** refers to an event or situation that is highly unlikely or impossible to occur. (ऐसी चीज जो कभी नहीं होगी)
 
 
• **Example: **Winning the lottery is something that will never happen to most people.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Something that will never happen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Something unplanned** (कुछ अनियोजित): Refers to an event or situation that occurs without prior planning.

 
 
• **Example:** Our trip to the beach was something unplanned, but we had a great time.
 
 
 
• **Something terrible** (कुछ भयानक): Refers to an event or situation that is very bad or unpleasant.
 
 
• **Example: **The storm last night was something terrible, causing a lot of damage.
 
 
 
• **Something that spoils relationships** (कुछ जो रिश्तों को खराब करता है): Refers to an action or event that damages or ruins relationships.
 
 
• **Example:** Lies and deceit are something that spoils relationships.
 
 

3a:Tb6e,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
